title: Modernizing Ground Truth: Four Shifts Toward Improving Reliability and Validity in AI in Education
reasoning: The paper focuses on the psychometrics of data labeling (reliability and validity) in educational AI contexts. While it discusses biases such as automation bias and 'beauty' or 'authority' biases in LLM judges and cites ethical considerations in its references, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious content, moral reasoning systems, or specific ethical frameworks.
